description: Header file defining the Windows-specific implementation of DHCP PAC file fetching, including class declarations, methods, and internal state management for DHCP-based proxy configuration retrieval.

classes.name: DhcpPacFileFetcherWin
classes.description: Windows-specific DHCP PAC file fetcher implementing the DhcpPacFileFetcher interface, managing DHCP adapter queries and PAC URL retrieval.

classes.name: AdapterQuery
classes.description: Inner class handling adapter name queries on a worker thread, with methods to perform DHCP adapter name retrieval and logging.

methods.name: Fetch
methods.description: Initiates fetching of PAC file via DHCP, with callback and logging.

methods.name: GetFetcherName
methods.description: Returns the name of the fetcher.

methods.name: GetCandidateAdapterNames
methods.description: Static method to retrieve DHCP-enabled adapter names, optionally logging info.

methods.name: num_pending_fetchers
methods.description: Returns the number of pending fetchers.

methods.name: GetTaskRunner
methods.description: Returns the task runner used for DHCP lookup tasks.

methods.name: AdapterQuery
methods.description: Class encapsulating DHCP adapter name query logic on a worker thread.

methods.name: GetCandidateAdapterNames
methods.description: Performs DHCP adapter name retrieval on a worker thread.
